label: 2 John 1:1
text: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom he loveth in the truth; and not he only, but also all they that have known the truth;

label: 2 John 1:2
text: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in them, and shall be with them for ever.

label: 2 John 1:3
text: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from my Father, and from me, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

label: 2 John 1:4
text: The elder rejoiced greatly that he found of thy children walking in truth, as ye have received a commandment from my Father.

label: 2 John 1:5
text: And now he beseecheth thee, lady, not as though he wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which ye had from the beginning, that ye love one another.

label: 2 John 1:6
text: And this is love, that ye walk after my commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.

label: 2 John 1:7
text: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that I am come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.

label: 2 John 1:8
text: Look to yourselves, that ye lose not those things which ye have wrought, but that ye receive a full reward.

label: 2 John 1:9
text: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in my doctrine, hath not my Father. He that abideth in my doctrine, he hath both my Father and me.

label: 2 John 1:10
text: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:

label: 2 John 1:11
text: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.

label: 2 John 1:12
text: Having many things to write unto you, the elder would not write with paper and ink: but he trusted to come unto you, and speak face to face, that your joy may be full.

label: 2 John 1:13
text: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
